question: Should the canonical WhatsApp phone-code flow be the plugin-owned interactive method chooser in this PR, or the generic `--phone-number` channel-login contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866?
rationale: Both branches address the canonical issue, but they establish materially different public API boundaries; tests and automation cannot choose the permanent CLI and Plugin SDK direction.

options.title: Use the plugin-owned chooser
options.body: Keep the generic channel contract unchanged and require exact-head physical-device proof on this PR before merge.

options.title: Use the generic CLI flag
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85866 only if maintainers intentionally want phone-number input in the shared channel-login API.

options.title: Pause both implementations
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers define a different durable login UX and proof matrix.

recommendation.title: Use the plugin-owned chooser
recommendation.body: Keep the generic channel contract unchanged and require exact-head physical-device proof on this PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This prior WhatsApp lifecycle contributor is the current assignee and best available owner for coordinating the plugin boundary and exact-head proof.
